_description: Reusable campaign templates for Realside AI outreach. Each vertical has pre-built configurations with industry-specific pain points, tone, CTA style, and personalization depth. Scripts like generate_owner_campaign.py and prospect_researcher.py auto-detect the prospect's industry and load the matching template.

tones.casual: Write like you're texting a friend who happens to be a business owner. Short sentences, no formal language, contractions everywhere.
tones.friendly: Warm and approachable but still professional. Use first names, light humor is OK, conversational flow.
tones.professional: Polished and business-appropriate. Still personable but more structured. Suitable for corporate or medical prospects.
tones.urgent: Time-sensitive framing. Reference seasonality, competitor moves, or market windows. Create FOMO without being pushy.

cta_styles.soft_ask: End with: 'Worth a quick call?' or 'Open to a quick chat?'
cta_styles.direct_ask: End with: 'What days work for a call?'
cta_styles.curiosity_driven: End with: 'Want to see how this works for {company}?'

email_lengths.short: Under 80 words. Punchy, one core idea, single CTA.
email_lengths.medium: 80-120 words. Room for one pain point, one proof point, one CTA.
email_lengths.long: 120-150 words. Full context: pain point, social proof, value prop, CTA. Use only when personalization depth is heavy.

personalization_depths.light: Use first name and company name only. Generic industry pain point. Good for high-volume campaigns.
personalization_depths.medium: Reference their specific industry, company size signals, and one detail from their website or listing. Good for targeted campaigns.
personalization_depths.heavy: Deep research: reference specific website content, recent news, reviews, team size, tech stack, or competitors. Best for high-value prospects.
